description: You Need to Calm Down is cute and the message is sweet but it's giving very 'I made this for the gays' energy and it's a little corny for me 😒💅 Like the 'shade never made anybody less gay' line is fun but the whole thing is so on the nose. It's not a bad song, it's just not her best work. Fine, but I skip it half the time, sorry not sorry ✨
